scope: Topology-resolved PPM SAL delivery for standard, label, clock, temperature, scene, and maintained specialist application commands

grounding.finding: The retained native C-Gate NET PINGU capture establishes the outbound point-to-point-to-multipoint source-route envelope: destination type 0x03, first bridge, route count, remaining bridges, target application, and SAL bytes. Published C-Bus routing limits this envelope to one through six bridges.

grounding.evidence: testdata/vectors/encode.jsonl direct application cases plus en-cmqttd-routed-* composition vectors
grounding.finding: Existing direct vectors establish each SAL payload. Routed vectors compose those unchanged payloads with the retained source-route envelope for Lighting, Trigger, Enable, Network Management, all ten specialist families, dynamic labels, Clock, Temperature, and named-scene Lighting ramps.

The shared transport appends one independently allocated PCI confirmation character after the checksummed C-Bus packet. Routed application control uses the no-retry allocation and accepts only that exact character; unrelated direct traffic and Reply Network CAL packets continue through the shared reader.

claimed_behavior: Lighting control, Trigger EVENT/INDICATORKILL, Enable SET, and Network Management LEARN/LOCATE use their retained SAL through a database-resolved one-to-six-bridge route.

Every maintained Air-Conditioning, Audio, Security, Measurement, Media Transport, Telephony, Identify, Short Message, Error Reporting, and Access Control outbound command uses the same route contract.
Lighting/Trigger/Enable dynamic labels, Clock DATE/TIME/REQUEST_REFRESH, Temperature Broadcast, and persisted cross-network named-scene actions are routed with the same exact confirmation policy.
Every routed command is sent once and waits for its exact PCI confirmation. Named scenes preflight all target routes before the first action, and routed actions receive no invented status readback.
Routed labels and clock/temperature updates do not populate the configured-network observation or application-state cache.
acceptance: Exact one/six-bridge encode vectors pin the route envelope boundaries and representative payloads for every admitted family.
Transport regressions pin exact confirmation matching, foreign-route isolation, invalid-route preflight, zero replay after an uncertain send, and direct traffic fanout while a routed send is pending.
Service regressions pin command aliases, target-network state scope, configured-network cache isolation, whole-scene route preflight, reconnect generation guards, and no routed status request.
limits: A positive PCI confirmation proves interface acceptance only. No remote application-level acknowledgement, Reply Network SAL observation, device state, controller action, timing, or persistence is claimed.

OEM eDLT synchronization metadata and unit readdressing remain separate point-to-point routed gaps; label cache, KFI and KEYGL5 control routing is tracked in native_cgate_routed_label_management.json.
ENABLE REMOVE remains a local saved-value operation. Live physical bridge and controller acceptance remains outstanding.
